title: Paloma and the Radiators
author: Ines Nakamura
blurb: Odile Coldharbour, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
